sourceRevision: The commit containing this ledger; generated content-manifest.json records the exact build commit and dirty-tree status.
policy: verified-local and source-reviewed are scoped implementation evidence, not deployed closure or expert approval. Partial/external-needed remain open. No claim that the entire site is fully current.

items.title: Replace the still-obsolete serverless comparison
items.outcome: Current provider comparison and lifecycle sources; no paid provisioning, pricing quotation or performance claim.
items.remaining: Provider documentation can change; human editorial review pending.

items.title: Repair and execute the complete dates tutorial
items.outcome: Every executable date block and recorded output run on PostgreSQL 18.6.
items.remaining: Publication pending.

items.title: Remove the obsolete pg_dump --oids recipe
items.outcome: Obsolete --oids removed; ordinary OID column round-trips through both formats.
items.remaining: Human operational review pending.

items.title: Make the restore path fail explicitly on errors
items.outcome: psql fail-fast and archive restore distinguished; malformed input, rows, constraints and sequences checked.
items.remaining: Trusted dump and transaction limits documented; human operational review pending.

items.title: Do not imply pausing replication makes a raw backup consistent
items.outcome: Unsafe paused-replica/raw-copy claim removed; supported physical base backup recovered in another server.
items.remaining: Coordinated storage snapshot procedure not exercised; security/operations review pending.

items.title: Propagate secure connection defaults to the companion guide
items.outcome: Verified TLS templates with protected temporary passfile; wrong hostname rejected.
items.remaining: No provider CA or native installation execution; human security review pending.

items.title: Correct connection defaults and installation-specific assumptions
items.outcome: Selected PostgreSQL user and PGDATABASE/-d overrides tested; Linux peer defaults scoped to installation.
items.remaining: Native Linux/macOS/Windows installations not re-executed.

items.title: Fix remaining foreign-key and NULL constraint generalizations
items.outcome: CHECK/NULL, NULLS NOT DISTINCT, non-primary UNIQUE foreign key and exclusion controls executed with exact SQLSTATEs.
items.remaining: Other engines and Prisma snippets excluded; human DDL review pending.

items.title: Distinguish physical from logical replication in pg_hba.conf
items.outcome: Physical replication rule passes physical protocol and rejects logical database connection until a database rule is added.
items.remaining: Human authentication review pending.

items.title: Fetch and apply the search exclusion flag
items.outcome: Search flag fetched and shared publication policy applied; transformer tests exercise excluded and hidden pages.
items.remaining: Live index verification pending.

items.title: Make publication, indexing, search and export visibility consistent
items.outcome: Explicit HTML/index/search/navigation/export matrix, typed flags and hidden example policy; owned Markdown exports are pruned across incremental unpublishing, removal and renames, with migration of legacy exports.
items.remaining: Deployment pending; hidden navigation alone intentionally leaves a public URL.

items.title: Prevent silent stale search publication
items.outcome: Required indexing fails on missing credentials and indexer errors. Complete indexed-record digests include transformed content and both revisions; the installed publisher refreshes unchanged MDX across successive publishing-code changes.
items.remaining: Public search UI confirms stale 2022 titles and obsolete Accelerate results. Required indexing and a hosted revision check must pass before release; publication credentials unavailable.

items.title: Align the advertised Node floor with TypeScript test execution
items.outcome: Node 22.18.0 and 24.18.0 tests, type-checking and clean-cache builds; application fixture also runs on both.
items.remaining: Hosted site builds passed for 4c5e1ec; check the current PR gates separately. Runtime support does not validate unreviewed articles.

items.title: Separate runnable commands from copied output
items.outcome: Date tutorial command/output pairs separated; roles label output, pseudocode and deliberate failures.
items.remaining: No blanket claim that every historical article block has been executed or reclassified.

items.title: Give diff copying a truthful contract
items.outcome: Diff copies the after-state; explicit patch retains markers; ordinary minus/operators preserved.
items.remaining: Publication pending.

items.title: Add database tutorial execution to CI
items.outcome: Pinned disposable PostgreSQL/PgBouncer/reference-app checks plus a separate eight-library compiler/runtime job; weekly and relevant-change triggers retain reports on failure.
items.remaining: Database/reference-app and new comparison jobs passed hosted checks at 36a95bf; inspect the current PR gates before release.

items.title: Test failure semantics, not just successful commands
items.outcome: Exact SQLSTATE/positive controls, concurrency, RLS, transport loss, restore and replay controls pass.
items.remaining: Guarantees scoped to fixtures; no production load or failure extrapolation.

items.title: Enforce verification metadata instead of relying on an updated date
items.outcome: All articles have explicit dispositions; executed status validates successful source and fixture hashes.
items.remaining: Owner roles need human assignment; unreviewed articles remain unreviewed.

items.title: Use exact pins when promising exact reproduction
items.outcome: Eight separate projects with exact library/driver/compiler pins and full npm locks; pinned database image digests and recorded installed versions.
items.remaining: New independent stable comparison only; no claim to recover the earlier refresh artifacts or reproduce preview versions.

items.title: Publish the comparison experiment, not only its narrative
items.outcome: Seven checks independently recreated for all eight stable libraries; TypeScript 7.0.2/6.0.3/5.9.3, unsuppressed diagnostics, asserted result types and disposable runtime controls pass. The new hosted comparison job also passed at 36a95bf.
items.remaining: Prisma 8, Drizzle 1 and TypedSQL preview results were removed from the grades; later releases need separate runs. Human comparison review pending.

items.title: Graduate provider recipes from offline checks to a real disposable run
items.outcome: Existing local/offline RDS scope retained; no paid provider action or real credentials used.
items.remaining: Need approved disposable AWS account/budget to prove provisioning, security and teardown.

items.title: Revalidate all six restored educational pages as a group
items.outcome: Six routes reviewed together: dates executed, connection defaults/TLS tested, URI corrected, type/installation/glossary scope notices and cross-links; production route observations recorded.
items.remaining: Full native installer/type catalogue execution and final deployed branch verification pending.

items.title: Add a numerical connection-budget exercise
items.outcome: Replica/worker/rollout budget plus actual ten-client saturation measurements and backend/client distinction.
items.remaining: Illustrative planning inputs and local timings are not production recommendations.

items.title: Teach transaction-pooling compatibility precisely
items.outcome: PgBouncer 1.26.0: four concurrent clients, two backends, conflicting named protocol statements, forced reassignment, backend recycling, disabled-feature negative control and transaction tenant state exercised.
items.remaining: Remaining feature rows are primary-source constraints; human security review pending.

items.title: Turn backup advice into an executable restore drill
items.outcome: End-to-end logical restore lab with failure injection, snapshot recovery point, elapsed measurement and restricted app read/write.
items.remaining: No production-size RTO, managed-provider PITR or cutover claim.

items.title: Add isolated developer, pull-request and coding-agent database workflows
items.outcome: Two developers and agent get distinct roles/databases, divergent writes, seed mismatch detection and automatic cleanup.
items.remaining: Cloud expiry/cost controls documented but not provisioned; human permission review pending.

items.title: Complete a multi-tenant isolation learning path
items.outcome: Same HTTP application across shared tables, schemas and databases; adversarial controls and tenant-wide additive migration.
items.remaining: Synthetic authentication only; cluster administrator remains trusted; human security review pending.

items.title: Complete concurrency, retries and idempotency labs
items.outcome: Lost-update/atomic/optimistic controls, deadlock, serialization retry and real HTTP loss after commit with idempotent replay.
items.remaining: Does not interrupt PostgreSQL transport during commit or test external payment effects.

items.title: Connect the guide through one maintained TypeScript application
items.outcome: One locked TypeScript application connects modeling, migrations, access, isolation, pooling and failure checkpoints over local HTTP.
items.remaining: Hosted deployment and production authentication/TLS replacement remain outside this local reference lab.

items.title: Build permission-aware retrieval and safe AI database exercises
items.outcome: Same labeled synthetic corpus for lexical/vector/hybrid, actual successful/failed rankings and latency; RLS and read-only bounded plans.
items.remaining: Hand-authored vectors; no external model quality or bill. Production evaluation needs its own corpus and cost evidence.

items.title: Demonstrate the transactional outbox and CDC failure modes
items.outcome: Dual-write failure, atomic outbox, duplicate delivery, version refusal, retention, ordering and actual logical-decoding checkpoints/slot cleanup.
items.remaining: Local test_decoding exercise; production connector restart/schema-history behavior not claimed.

items.title: Trigger review from upstream lifecycle events
items.outcome: Primary lifecycle and npm publisher sources, scoped owner/path/lane tasks and simulated changes; scheduled workflow covers the comparison as well as engine/provider lifecycles.
items.remaining: Fingerprints trigger review, not automatic behavioral claims. Human owner assignment and patch-release checks required.

items.title: Preserve technical notes while removing promotions from Markdown
items.outcome: TechnicalNote preserves contextual prerequisites and mappings; promotional PrismaOutlinks omitted from Markdown; exporter tests.
items.remaining: Wrapper migration does not independently validate every integration claim or bump article dates.

items.title: Extend link checks beyond internal anchors
items.outcome: Asset/srcset/social/canonical/Markdown/sitemap validator with negative fixtures and full build.
items.remaining: Remote HTTP behavior recorded separately.

items.title: Verify the deployed route, robots and representation matrix
items.outcome: Deployment checks require explicit environment and canonical root. HTTP negative controls reject bad canonicals, production noindex, invalid/blocked production robots policies and unblocked previews despite matching revisions and HTTP 200.
items.remaining: A working current-commit Vercel preview, actual origin robots and hosted route/Markdown/manifest checks remain required. Local HTTP fixtures do not establish hosted readiness.

items.title: Expose a content revision across deployed surfaces
items.outcome: Content hash and full source commit propagated to HTML, Markdown and search; hosted checks require both. Archive builds use deployment metadata; CI runs a full no-Git build. Stale publisher commits are rejected by executable HTTP/search tests.
items.remaining: Working Vercel preview and live-index agreement remain release blockers; GitHub/local builds cannot close them.

items.title: Run browser-based accessibility and responsive checks
items.outcome: Real browser keyboard/copy/390px layout/menu/search fallback/dismissal and JavaScript-disabled reading; tested WCAG-tagged axe checks have no violations.
items.remaining: Manual screen-reader task completion and broader device/real-user performance checks remain pending.

items.title: Make search relevance a tested reader journey
items.outcome: Public UI baseline saved: date and pooling journeys find a lesson, certificate and isolation queries return no result, restore query selects RDS instead of the logical restore lesson. Transformer now retains full prose and omits result tables/promotions.
items.remaining: Need publication and a successful rerun against the deployed revision; old results cannot substantiate the new content.

items.title: Validate contextual CTAs with outcomes rather than more placements
items.outcome: Explicit CTA transport with bounded metadata tested; measurement plan distinguishes learning and qualified activation from clicks. Retired Universal Analytics transport removed after a production CSP rejection was observed.
items.remaining: No private funnel/outcome observations; consented downstream event joins and reporting need analytics/product owner.

items.outcome: Each of the forty inventory items maps to source/evidence and an explicit remaining acceptance boundary.
